'''Teklos''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The [["Teklos" Mobile Command Base]] took its name from the planet after it was adapted to combat [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gangs]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[March]] [[2023]] that Teklos was validated for a future update of [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion 2023.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-03-25}}</ref>
